# Samrita Maharjan Civil Engineering Portfolio

This website presents Samrita Maharjan as an entry-level Civil Engineer in Lalitpur, Nepal.

## Professional direction

- Junior Civil Engineer roles
- Site coordination support
- AutoCAD drafting support
- Surveying assistance
- Quantity estimation
- Construction documentation
- Site reporting and drawing review

## Education

- Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Madan Bhandari Memorial Academy Nepal, 2022-2026. Final official result is marked pending until publication.
- Higher Secondary Education (+2), Science, Moonlight Secondary School, Kumaripati.
- Secondary Education Examination, Adarsha Saula Yubak Secondary School, Sainbu Bungamati.

## Portfolio principles

- Claims are intentionally limited to entry-level capability.
- Academic records are grouped for recruiter review.
- Sensitive registration, symbol, and serial numbers are not published as searchable text.
- The website does not claim senior-level experience, invented metrics, or fake testimonials.
